Chapter 7016: Ginger Gets Spicier With Age

Chapter 7016: Ginger Gets Spicier With Age

Heaven’s Equal, Parting Hook, Ash-serpent, and Immortal Bronze made the atmosphere tense.

Primordial immortals were rare sights but four have gathered at the same place for the celestial source.

It became abundantly clear that this source had nothing to do with regular immortals. Even golden immortals couldn’t take the stage.

“Exciting.” Xiaolou Tingxue said sarcastically.

Immortal Bronze and Ash-serpent exchanged glances, clearly having reached an agreement.

“Everyone’s here, but there is only one source.” Heaven’s Equal smiled.

“Perhaps we can have a discussion.” Immortal Bronze said.

“Nothing to say, it belongs to the strongest.” Ash-serpent interjected.

The two were playing “good cop” and “bad cop”.

“Then you wish to fight?” Xiaolou Tingxue directed his saber energy toward Ash-serpent.

Ash-serpent was irritated but didn’t wish to fight.

“The first to come gets priority. Our race noticed it first.” Golden Machine Immortal spoke, having Immortal Bronze as his backer.

“I agree, we found it first.” Another immortal chimed in and chose to side with the fortress race. This was the only chance for them to share the spoils.

“That’s logical.” Immortal Bronze said.

“Those who are here first can be the first to die as well.” Xiaolou Tingxue said.

Heaven’s Equal had a serious expression and opened his mouth to speak. However, Timeflow Lord pulled his sleeve.

The latter was an overlord, just another member of the branch. This time, Heaven’s Equal especially brought him along.

“Ancestor, I know her.” Timeflow whispered while pointing at Ye Fantian who was trapped inside the withering domain.

“Who is she?” Heaven’s Equal asked, not caring much about an overlord.

“She spent time in Duality Enterprise and received a lot of help, certainly an inhabitant of the nine worlds. It appears she came to Ruin long ago.” Timeflow whispered.

Many thoughts flashed in Heaven’s Equal’s mind upon hearing this.

“Haha.” He laughed before entering the withering domain erected by Autumn Wind and his allies.

“Looks like Dusk already has a master. First come, first served.” Heaven’s Equal said.

Till Ancestor and the others didn’t understand what was going on. Mo Xiangsheng, on the other hand, shouted: “Yes, this is Fantian Dynasty’s ancestral ground, the celestial source belongs to Fellow Daoist Fantian.”

“As you can see, it belongs to this young friend over here. Everyone, it’s time to go.” Heaven’s Equal said.

Everyone exchanged glances, wondering about his intention of helping a puny overlord.

“Haha, ginger gets spicier with age.” Ash-serpent laughed: “You are trying to monopolize the source while masking it as a good deed.”

“Ash-serpent, do not judge a gentleman with your petty heart.” Heaven’s Equal glared.

“I am merely speaking the truth. You claim that it already has a master but the moment we leave, you will wipe them out and seize it.” Ash-serpent wasn’t afraid: “Looks like we need to learn from you, Senior.”

This was on everyone’s mind as well. However, they didn’t dare to speak out against a primordial immortal.

“Such is the petty mind. I will not lay a hand on this celestial source. Fellow Daoists, can you all be magnanimous and do the same?” Heaven’s Equal laughed heartily and asked the crowd.
